verdicts.why: Bobbi Morse first appears in S2#5, where she breaks cover, joins Coulson's team and is revealed as Hunter's ex-wife; bare S2 is too early.
Bobbi first appears in S2#5, rescuing Simmons from Hydra and bringing her home to the Playground, where Fitz and Simmons reunite.
In S2#6 May, Morse and Hunter work the Okinawa and Belgium missions, and May tells Bobbi in the cockpit that she was married; May catches Bobbi stealing the toolbox in S2#15.
Bobbi first appears in S2#5, undercover in Hydra on Coulson's orders to watch Simmons, and joins his team at the end of the episode.
In S3#1 Bobbi tracks a gun seized from an ATCU soldier to Rosalind Price; the Endotex infiltration, the Giyera fight and Banks helping them escape on Price's orders are S3#8.
In S2#5 Bobbi, as Hydra head of security, and Bakshi discover there is a mole in the facility; her interrogation of the captured Bakshi is S2#8.
At the end of S1#22 Raina gives a mysterious man a photo of Skye and tells him she has found his daughter; Cal kills Jiaying to save Daisy in S2#22.
Gordon first deals with Cal in S2#13: he teleports him out of the Manitowoc stand-off with Coulson and tells him he is no Inhuman, just a science experiment.
Cal only appears at the end of S2#2, and his wife first comes up in S2#8, when he finds the remains of the woman Whitehall dissected, his wife, and vows vengeance.
In S2#5 Cal delivers the Obelisk to Whitehall and offers an alliance against their common enemy, Phil Coulson, after Coulson refused Raina's bid to take Skye to him; bare S2 predates Cal.
In S.O.S. Part 1 (S2#21) Coulson helps Cal see that Jiaying is the true monster; the Iliad infiltration, Jiaying's death and the memory wipe are Part 2 (S2#22).
Talbot absorbs Creel in S5#21 and Daisy blasts Talbot into space in S5#22, so neither fact holds from S5#1.
The Superior's attempt was on Talbot's life, not Creel's: Creel quits after Talbot is shot, and Hale recruits him in S5#11 saying she is putting together a team, not hiring a gun.
Christian's abuse of Grant is part of the show from S1#3 (mentioned) and S1#8 (flashbacks); Grant forces the confession at the well and kills Christian and their parents in S2#8.
In S4#5 Mack sends Quake to lead Davis and Prince into the infected prison to find Coulson and May; the L.T. Koenig mission is S4#12.
Koenig greets the team and shows them round Providence in S1#18, saying lanyards come after clearance; the lie-detector tests and his murder by Ward are S1#19.
In S4#3 Robbie and Daisy stop the thugs stealing Gabe's wheelchair and Gabe talks with her at the Reyes house; she flies him to Zephyr One in S4#6.
In S3#15 Malick, in the Transia exoskeleton, beats Daisy down and is about to crush her when Hinton stops him; Daisy kills him under Hive's control in S3#17.
The Daisy LMD shoots Talbot in the head at the international meeting in S4#22, not earlier in S4.
Talbot becomes Graviton in S5#19 and incapacitates Daisy on Qovas' ship in S5#20; in S5#22 he tries to absorb her in Chicago and she blasts him into space.
Skye finds Koenig's body and realizes Ward is Hydra in S1#19, then plays along while secretly working against him; S1#20 is the open confrontation.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#5
value.text: General Hale blames Daisy for shooting Glenn Talbot and orders all S.H.I.E.L.D. agents arrested.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A general who blames Daisy for Talbot's shooting and hunts S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Hale blames for Talbot's shooting.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
split.text: Hale secretly leads Hydra and plans to turn Quake into a weapon with Gravitonium, but when her daughter Ruby spins out of control, Hale surrenders to Daisy and helps her storm the Hydra base.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A general who secretly leads Hydra, then surrenders to Daisy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hale blames her for Talbot and plans to weaponize her, then turns to her for help.

verdicts.why: Earlier is right but S5#12 is not the start: Hale first appears in S5#5, where, since Daisy was seen shooting Talbot, she orders all S.H.I.E.L.D. agents arrested and grills Fitz about it. The S5#18 split stands.
Hive only returns at the end of S3#10, and his control of Daisy begins in S3#17, when he uses her to kill Malick and she leaves to destroy the base.
In S1#3 Skye infiltrates Quinn's Malta party and tricks him into believing she is betraying S.H.I.E.L.D. for the Rising Tide; Quinn shoots her in S1#13.
In S4#8 Mace publicly clears Daisy's name and reinstates her as an agent; Daisy rescues Mace from the Watchdogs' hired ex-Hydra agents in S4#10.
Jiaying first meets Skye in S2#16 at Afterlife, where she becomes her guide and the episode shows she is Skye's mother; bare S2 is too early.
Garrett first appears in S1#14, where he interrogates Quinn and learns the Clairvoyant ordered Skye shot; bare S1 is too early.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#3
value.text: Kasius has Daisy Johnson captured and is pleased to hold Quake, the Destroyer of Worlds.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Kree overlord who has Daisy captured.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#6
split.text: Kasius tries to sell Daisy to buyers and makes her fight his enforcer Sinara as her exhibition.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Kree overlord who makes Daisy fight and tries to sell her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A prize Kasius makes fight for him and tries to sell.

verdicts.why: The enmity starts in S5#3, when Kasius's men trap and capture Daisy on Deke's tip and Kasius gloats over her; the bidders are only mentioned in S5#4, so the sale moves into the S5#6 split with the Sinara fight.
Lincoln first appears in S2#16, when Gordon brings Skye to Afterlife and Lincoln explains how the transformed are guided.
In S3#1 Lincoln wants to be left alone; in S3#3 Daisy reveals she is attracted to him and kisses him, and he goes with her. He dies with Hive in S3#22.
Ward is Skye's S.O. through most of S1; May first offers to be her new S.O. in S1#21 after Ward is exposed.
Fury first appears at the end of S1#2, scolding Coulson over the plane and warning him of the risk Skye poses.
Raina's interest in Skye starts in S1#22, when she tells Ward chasing Skye matters more and tells Cal she has found his daughter; in S2#9 she tells Skye they are both worthy ones.
The Diviner encases Skye and Raina in Terrigenesis cocoons in the Kree city in S2#10; Jiaying kills Raina in S2#21.
Daisy first meets Robin and Polly in the six-months-later coda of S3#22, where she gives Robin the carved robin her father made.

Price first meets Daisy in S3#4, introducing herself when Daisy and Mack face down the ATCU, and Daisy questions what happens to captured Inhumans; Daisy saves her from Lash's drop off a balcony in S3#7.
Sinara is there when the Kree Watch captures Quake in S5#3; they fight in the pit in S5#6, and Daisy kills her in S5#9.
In S4#21 Coulson and May fight Ivanov's robot bodies on the oil platform; Quake fights his LMD body at the meeting in S4#22, blasting it apart as Ghost Rider's chain pulls it.
Shockley first appears in S4#12, where Quake blasts him into a wall at the Labyrinth and he brings her to her knees with his taser rod; he becomes an Inhuman in S4#13.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#3
value.text: When Jemma poses as Peggy Carter at Area 51 in 1955, Daniel Sousa sees through the act and arrests her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Sousa catches posing as Peggy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who arrests Jemma in 1955.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#4
split.text: After the team saves him from the death history had planned for him, Sousa joins them aboard Zephyr One.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Sousa catches posing as Peggy, then joins on Zephyr One.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who arrests Jemma in 1955, then joins the team.

verdicts.why: The move to S7#3 and Area 51 is right: Sousa outs Simmons' Peggy act there and wakes on the Zephyr in S7#4. By 1955 Sousa is S.H.I.E.L.D.'s West Coast Security Chief, not SSR, so the card lines are fixed.
